messages:
maya: Quick heads-up: I'm proposing we scope an "Inference Advice v0" alpha. Goal: deliver actionable batching/caching/quant recs for web chat routes + lightweight eval-alerting. Need fast alignment on acceptance criteria and rollout.

oleg: Love an alpha. Suggest we lock traffic to web chat "/v1/chat" only and target conversational 1M tokens/day to keep infra bounded. Also p99 latency target 350ms for the alpha cohort.

sam: For models let's restrict to a couple of representative families (LLaMA2-13B, redmond-v1) so profiling + quant sanity checks are meaningful. Exclude mobile clients for now.

maya: Draft acceptance checklist (v0):
- Scope: /v1/chat (web), models: LLaMA2-13B, redmond-v1
- Output: per-route suggested batching window (percentile-based), prefix-KV cache hint, quant level suggestion (int8/int4 with safety flag)
- Eval alerts: run seeded prompt suite (~150 prompts) every 4h; trigger alert if quality metric drops >4% OR hallucination heuristics rise >2.5%
- Observability: per-route token cost delta, p50/p95/p99 latencies, recommendation adoption (auto-applied vs manual apply), rollback counts
- Rollout policy: canary -> 15% -> 40% -> 100%; auto-fallback to stable variant if errors spike >1.5% for 3m

gina: How do we define "recommendation adoption"? Propose two metrics: applied_by_console (manual) and auto_applied (system). We should also expose a per-customer opt-out toggle in Console.

oleg: Implementation detail: batching window should be computed as p90 inter-arrival but capped at 60ms for web UX. Make it a suggestion with expected impact estimate (latency/cost tradeoff).

sam: Eval harness plan: lightweight scoring (ROUGE + custom hallucination detector) and store diffs only. Keep the eval pass under 2 minutes to run frequently. I can build prototype runner.

priya: Ops note: need audit logs for any automated changes and a manual pause button. Also require generated recs to include a short rationale string for the Console UI.

maya: Rollout gates (proposal): 72h canary checks, acceptance if: adoption >=8% on canary, no seeded-set regression >2%, stability errors <1%. Otherwise immediate rollback + postmortem.

oleg: Runtime checklist for eng-runtime: route-level async batching hooks, KV prefix cache instrumentation, quant fallback paths, telemetry for p99 by model variant. I can take batching ownership.

sam: I'll take seeded eval harness and scoring. Gina — capture Console mock for opt-out/pause and rec rationale UI?

gina: Yep, will mock by EOD Thursday. Implementation spans 2 sprints.

maya: Owners + near-term milestones:
- Batching infra (oleg): PR by next Tue
- Eval harness (sam): prototype by next Wed
- Console pause/audit + rationale (gina): mock Thu, dev backlog next two sprints
- Telemetry (priya/ops): baseline metrics + adoption flags in 1 sprint

maya: One policy question: should alpha auto-apply recs to customer tenants? My position: read-only for customers, auto-apply for internal Redwood test orgs.

oleg: Agree with read-only for customers for safety, auto-apply internally to validate effects.

sam: Same. We'll flip to customer auto-apply only after stable window and docs + explainer copy.

gina: Add an inline "what changes" diff in Console and link to docs. Also require a notification to customers when we roll a change.

ops-bot: Canary created for /v1/chat. Alerting hooks deployed to canary. :white_check_mark:

maya: OK I'll write a short RFC with the checklist, owners, and rollout plan. If no objections by EOD I'll create the issue and schedule kickoff. Thanks all. :rocket:
